claim: Application Auto Scaling predictive scaling analyzes metric data from up to the past 14 days, makes an hourly forecast for the next 48 hours, and updates the forecast every 6 hours.
question: How much history does Application Auto Scaling predictive scaling read, how far ahead does it forecast, and how often is the forecast updated?

qualifiers.scope: per Application Auto Scaling predictive scaling policy

evidence.quote: After you create the policy, predictive scaling starts analyzing metric data from up to the past 14 days to identify patterns.
It uses this analysis to generate an hourly forecast of capacity requirements for the next 48 hours.
The forecast is updated every 6 hours using the latest CloudWatch data.

note: Demand d62. Same 6-hour refresh as EC2 Auto Scaling (see ec2-auto-scaling-change-predictive-forecasts-every-six-hours).

claim: Application Auto Scaling predictive scaling needs at least 24 hours of historical metric data to start forecasting, and forecasts are more effective when the history spans two full weeks.
question: How much metric history does Application Auto Scaling predictive scaling need before it can forecast?

values.display: at least 24 hours of historical data

qualifiers.scope: per Application Auto Scaling predictive scaling policy

evidence.quote: Predictive scaling needs at least 24 hours of historical data to start forecasting.
However, forecasts are more effective if historical data spans two full weeks.
